title: Person / Resource Policy

ref.description: Opaque stable private-runtime reference. Do not put names, addresses, credentials or other secrets here merely for convenience.

resource_class.description: Optional class such as device, project, file, location, account, service or household zone.

notes_ref.description: Private reference to supporting context; never inline secrets in a public policy registry.
